2023-12

Devfest Bandung 2023

Attended DevFest Bandung 2023, a premier community-driven technology conference gathering developers, technology advocates, and industry pioneers to explore the next generation of digital tools and systems. The event provided deep insights into leveraging emerging technologies for robust product development. Throughout the conference, I engaged in technical tracks focused on several foundational technology areas: The Rise of Generative AI: Gained valuable knowledge on the early landscape of Google’s GenAI tools, exploring practical application frameworks using prompt design patterns and foundation APIs to enhance software intelligence. Modern Web & Mobile Ecosystems: Participated in sessions focused on scalable app development, touching upon advanced Flutter components, Kotlin foundations for modern Android, and high-performance UI strategies alongside industry experts. Cloud Architecture & Data Engineering: Explored best practices in managing modern backends, focusing on data optimization pipelines, robust infrastructure cost management, and practical approaches to secure development life cycles. The event offered an invaluable environment to exchange technical strategies, participate in interactive developer dialogues, and expand my professional network within the vibrant tech ecosystem.

2024-09-14

OIM UNIKU 2024

Achieved 3rd Place at OIM UNIKU 2024 (Olimpiade Intelektual Mahasiswa) in the PKM-PM (Community Service) category. The awarded proposal focused on introducing an innovative and sustainable solution to local communities by integrating modern technology with organic waste management. During the competition and project formulation, the key highlights included: Smart Maggot Cultivation: Developed a comprehensive proposal for cultivating black soldier fly (BSF) larvae (maggot) as high-protein animal feed, aimed at tackling local organic waste issues and lowering animal feed costs for farmers. App-Integrated Solutions: Designed a specialized mobile application framework to monitor growth cycles, manage feeding schedules, and facilitate community training, making the cultivation process highly accessible and data-driven. Community Empowerment & Impact: Structured a sustainable implementation strategy to educate and empower local communities, fostering economic resilience and promoting environmental sustainability through the digital circular economy.

2024-12

Devfest Bandung 2024

Attended DevFest Bandung 2024, a premier community-led tech conference that brought together developers, industry experts, and tech enthusiasts to explore Google's rapidly evolving ecosystem. The event focused heavily on leveraging next-generation technologies to solve real-world problems and build smarter applications. During the event, I participated in sessions and tech tracks that covered several core pillars: Generative AI & Machine Learning: Gained deep insights into Google’s GenAI capabilities, exploring practical implementations of Gemini models, Vertex AI, and how developers can integrate intelligent workflows into existing systems. Cloud Infrastructure & Security: Explored modern cloud practices, focusing on optimizing application deployment, managing scalable backends, and implementing robust security measures within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Modern Mobile & Web Ecosystems: Attended deep dives into modern development frameworks, including advanced state management in Flutter, capabilities in Android development, and building high-performance web applications. The conference provided an excellent platform to stay ahead of the technical curve, engage in insightful discussions during Q&A sessions, and network with Google Developer Experts (GDEs) and the local tech community.

2025-10-16

Guest Speaker PKKMB FKOM 2026

Invited as a guest speaker and senior mentor to share insights and experiences with junior students regarding the Bangkit Academy (MBKM) program and my journey as a developer. In this session, I focused on inspiring and guiding the next generation of tech talent by covering several key areas: Demystifying Bangkit Academy: Provided a comprehensive overview of the Bangkit MBKM program, explaining the learning paths (Cloud Computing, Mobile Development, and Machine Learning), selection process, and the benefits of converting it to college credits (SKS). Developer Roadmap & Real-World Experience: Shared practical insights on what it takes to be a developer today, including the essential tech stacks, tools, and the importance of portfolio building based on my personal development experience. Navigating Challenges in Tech: Openly discussed the ups and downs of learning modern technologies, managing time effectively between academic responsibilities and intensive tech programs, and developing crucial soft skills like problem-solving and collaboration. Through this sharing session, I aimed to empower junior students to take proactive steps in their tech journeys, leverage MBKM opportunities, and build a strong foundation for their future careers in the tech industry.

2025-11-29

Devfest Bandung 2025

Attended DevFest Bandung 2025, the biggest community-led technology conference in Indonesia, held at Maranatha Christian University. Grounded in the main theme of "Building Safe, Secure, and Scalable Solutions with AI and Cloud," the event provided an immersive environment to explore cutting-edge Google technologies and industry best practices. During the event, I participated in several specialized tracks and learning zones, including: AI Alchemy Lab & AI Builders Zone: Explored the latest advancements in Artificial Intelligence, including hands-on insights into Gemini models (Imagen and Veo 3) and practical applications of machine learning workflows. Cloud Architect Hub: Deep-dived into scalable infrastructure, cloud security, and optimizing modern architectures alongside Google Developer Experts (GDEs). Mobile & Web Development: Gained insights into cross-platform development by demystifying Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) architecture, exploring what's new in Firebase, and learning how AI accelerates dev-to-prod deployment. Beyond the technical sessions, the event was a fantastic opportunity to connect with tech community leaders, industry architects, and thousands of fellow developers, expanding my network and professional horizons within the tech ecosystem.

2025-12-20

PBK FEST

Invited as a featured speaker at PBK FEST 2026 to deliver a keynote session on "AI Agents: Shaping the Landscape of Future Tech & Digital Economy." This session aimed to bridge the gap between advanced artificial intelligence and its practical implications on modern industries and economic growth. During the presentation, I shared deep insights into several key areas: The Evolution of AI Agents: Demystified the concept of autonomous AI agents, highlighting how they differ from traditional chatbots by executing complex, multi-step workflows independently. Driving the Digital Economy: Discussed the economic impact of AI agents in automating industries, optimizing business operations, and creating new market opportunities within the digital ecosystem. Future Tech Frameworks: Provided a technical breakdown of how developers can leverage modern AI frameworks and LLMs to build secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent agents. The session concluded with an engaging panel discussion and a live Q&A, inspiring students and tech enthusiasts to actively build, innovate, and prepare for the next wave of AI-driven digital transformation.

2026-05

PBK Makrab Guest Speaker

Invited as a guest speaker at the Malam Keakraban (Makrab) event organized by PBK, specifically tailored for onboarding and welcoming new organization members. Moving beyond traditional seminars, this sharing session was designed to foster a strong sense of community and alignment within the organization. During the event, I led a practical and engaging discussion focused on: Organizational Onboarding & Vision: Shared the core values, culture, and long-term vision of PBK to help new members understand their roles and feel a strong sense of belonging from day one. Balancing Tech & Leadership: Shared personal experiences on how to effectively balance intensive developer paths (such as tech projects or MBKM programs) with organizational responsibilities and active leadership. Growth Mindset & Community: Encouraged the new members to view PBK not just as an organization, but as a collaborative sandbox for improving both technical foundations and essential soft skills like teamwork, communication, and adaptability. The session wrapped up with an interactive Q&A and networking circle, aiming to inspire the new cohort to actively contribute, innovate, and thrive throughout their journey with PBK.
